text:
incident-bot: ALERT — SLO breach detected for /streaming/infer on shared-gpu-pool-2. p95 jumped from ~220ms to ~700ms; p99 from ~1.9s to ~5.2s over the last 7m. Streaming stall rate +35%. No 5xx spike. Trigger: slo-monitor (rule: streaming_latency_p99 > 3s). Paging @oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/slo/streaming

maria-sre: ack, I'm on it. tagging @david-runtime for runtime help. collecting initial context.

david-runtime: oncall here. grabbing host and cgroup metrics for nodes in shared-gpu-pool-2. ping if you see specific tenant ids.

sara-eng: saw a couple of customer support tickets about long stalls (~20–30s perceived by frontend) but no errors yet. josh-cs, any confirmed customers?
josh-cs: two high-touch customers (tenant-42, tenant-87) reported slow streaming responses to their streaming endpoints ~10m ago, both on the shared pool. CS has temporarily paused heavy batch jobs for tenant-87.

maria-sre: ok, getting logs. stack traces show stalls at streaming write stage, not model compute. suspect IO/backpressure. pulling iostat and blkio stats for gpu-node-17 (most affected).

maria-sre: iostat snippet (host gpu-node-17):
```
Device            tps    kB_read/s    kB_wrtn/s    await    svctm   %util
sda               68.3      12.4        980.1      25.4     1.20    92.1
nvme0n1          120.7       8.3       1450.6      42.7     1.05    99.3
```

maria-sre: blkio cgroup weights showing heavy write pressure for cgroup for tenant-42: weight 1000 vs others ~500. cgstat shows write_bytes spikes aligning with stalls.

david-runtime: found repeated KV cache eviction logs around the same time (rapid model kv writes). tail log: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] stall_detector: tenant=tenant-42 stall_ms=2200 type=streaming_writeback reason=blkio_wait
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] kv_cache: evict key=cache-xxx size=34MB tenant=tenant-42
```

sara-eng: tenant-42 recently started a checkpoint/backup job (confirmed by infra-job logs) that writes large amounts to disk. likely noisy neighbor causing IO contention with streaming path.

maria-sre: mitigation plan: 1) throttle tenant-42 IO (blkio weight) 2) if that fails, migrate tenant-42 to dedicated-reserve-3 3) add temporary rate limit at router for tenant-42 streaming requests to reduce tail pressure. I'll try (1) now.

david-runtime: command to lower blkio weight (going to run on host):
```bash
echo 200 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/docker/<container-id>/blkio.weight
```
(Using systemd/cgroup v1 path on this cluster)

sara-eng: applied blkio weight to tenant-42 container -> set to 200. watching metrics.

maria-sre: within 60s p99 dropped from 5.2s -> 2.1s, p95 -> 360ms. stall rate falling but still above threshold.

david-runtime: good. starting migration of tenant-42 to dedicated-reserve-3 as a fallback (kubectl cordon + drain / pod eviction). copying live session state where possible, routing will follow once pods ready.

sara-eng: eviction/migration triggered. rebalancer job ID rebal-20260315-01.

deploy-bot: rebal-20260315-01 completed: moved 3 pods (tenant-42) -> dedicated-reserve-3. routing updated (svc annotations).

maria-sre: after migration p99 -> 820ms, p95 -> 170ms. streaming stalls dropped to baseline. marking incident as mitigated.

josh-cs: notifying customers now with summary and ETA for follow-up root cause. will copy SRE notes.

maria-sre: preliminary RCA: noisy neighbor (tenant-42) running heavy background checkpoint/writeback to disk while sharing GPU pool IO path, causing blkio wait and KV cache eviction-induced streaming stalls. Contributing factors: no per-tenant IO throttling alert, shared pool without per-tenant io metrics surfaced to SLO monitor.

maria-sre: immediate actions done: lowered blkio weight for tenant-42, migrated tenant-42 to dedicated pool, applied temporary router rate limit.

maria-sre: follow-ups (owners):
- eng-runtime (david-runtime): implement per-tenant blkio iostat alerting, add automatic soft-evict policy when per-tenant write_bytes > X for Y minutes.
- eng-sre (sara-eng): add per-tenant p99 streaming and iowait annotation to slo monitor dashboards.
- platform (maria-sre): add tenant-backed QoS profiles and default blkio weight limit for shared pools.

david-runtime: filing infra ticket INFRA-5412 with steps and reproduction notes.
josh-cs: CS follow-up: offer tenant-42 a briefing and recommend using dedicated-reserve for heavy IO workloads.

maria-sre: incident severity set to Sev3 (customer impact but mitigated). closing incident for now. feel free to reopen if p99 creeps back. :thumbsup:
